name: Long Meadow
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #10 — the wide horizontal run: FIVE islands (alternating trampoline/bubblegum) strung left-to-right over one long void with 600px gaps, and a single spring throne over the middle island. Its hook is length — a full traverse is four committed boosts, so fuel management and chase lines matter. Pure geometry, no hazard.

GEOMETRY: I1 (trampoline x0..880 top1080) / I2 (bubblegum x1480..2360 top1040) / I3 (trampoline x2960..3840 top1080) / I4 (bubblegum x4440..5320 top1040) / I5 (trampoline x5920..6800 top1080), four 600px void gaps between. One spring THRONE (x3220..3580 top560 h48) hovers 520px above I3. Full-width lethal void (rim y1260); bounds -560..7360, ~560px side runway; bottom y1920 = 712-780px recovery sky.

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~320 bubblegum / ~527 spring max; normal_boost_max 760 crosses a 600px gap in ~0.9s @ ~25 fuel, bounce refunds +20; super 2800 clears all):
- GAPS I1..I5 (four x 600px over void): each > 527 max spring drift and >> 395/320 drift. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED at every gap; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top560): 520px above I3 (1080). Trampoline apex 270 reaches y810 -> 270px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED; SUPER earns it. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: island bottoms (1152-1208) to bottom blast (1920) = 712-768px recovery sky (>= 650). Verb: FLY.
- Every gap exceeds a spring bounce's reach and the throne sits above spring apex, so a full traverse is impossible without repeated boosting. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.
